title: Nascent Soul Embryo
summary: Zhou Lin, who owes Li Muwan his life, guards the secret room she made, where Wang Lin's clone and Li Muwan plan to use the furnace talisman to tap the Seven Heaven-Seizing Furnaces, built by the Cloud Sky Sect's founding ancestor, while the sect refines pills. Ouyang Zi leads the furnace opening with his pill-sacrifice technique, burning rank 4 pills to raise a rank 5 one, and Wang Lin's sealed pill turns out to be a rank 7 Green Cloud Pill. Li Muwan steps in to steady the furnaces for Ouyang Zi, and his rank 5 pill succeeds while the huge vortex hides the power flowing to Wang Lin. Sun Zhenwei then reveals he has killed Zhou Lin for acting secretly and threatens Li Muwan into her wedding dress. The clone forms a Nascent Soul embryo, but his Ji Realm divine sense fights the formation. Guests such as Tian Yi of the Luoye Sect arrive and the double cultivation ceremony begins.
